args.name: mcp
args.description: Run the stdio MCP entry instead of the GUI: a running, MCP-enabled app serves the tools; with no app, run `--headless` for the core-native server

args.name: headless
args.description: Force the core-native headless MCP server (no window)

analyzers.description: List the analyzer catalog, or explain one analyzer's options

args.name: id
args.description: Analyzer id to explain (default: list the catalog)

args.name: json
args.description: Emit the catalog (or the one analyzer) as JSON instead of a table

analyze.description: Decode file(s) and run analyzer(s) over a window

args.name: file
args.description: Audio file(s) to decode and analyze

args.name: tool
args.description: Analyzer id to run (repeatable); required unless --all

args.name: all
args.description: Run every analyzer in the catalog

args.name: start
args.description: Window start in seconds (default 0)

args.name: end
args.description: Window end in seconds (default: full duration)

args.name: windows
args.description: Window list file: one `start,end[,tool,tool…]` per line (# comments allowed). Runs every line in one process; not with --start/--end

args.name: param
args.description: Shared param patch K=V (repeatable): fftSize, hop, windowFn, channel, resampleTo, freqMinHz, freqMaxHz, randomizedOverlap

args.name: option
args.description: Per-tool option patch [TOOL.]K=V (repeatable); `analyzers <ID>` lists the keys, defaults, and ranges

args.name: filter
args.description: Apply a filter GraphSpec (JSON file) before analysis

args.name: full
args.description: Include the raw result arrays (default: compacted)

args.name: summary
args.description: Emit the summary only, without result arrays (mutually exclusive with --full)

args.name: format
args.description: Data export format: json (JSONL / provenance envelope) or csv (wide matrix). Default json

args.name: csv
args.description: Shorthand for --format csv

args.name: out
args.description: Write results to a file (one result) or a directory (one file per result) instead of stdout

args.name: pretty
args.description: Pretty-print a single result instead of one JSON line per result

args.name: fail-fast
args.description: Stop at the first failing file/tool

synth.description: Render a synth graph and (optionally) analyze the result

args.name: graph
args.description: Synth GraphSpec (JSON file) to render

args.name: seconds
args.description: Rendered length in seconds (default 5)

args.name: tool
args.description: Analyzer id to run (repeatable); omit to print the rendered source summary

args.name: all
args.description: Run every analyzer in the catalog

args.name: start
args.description: Window start in seconds

args.name: end
args.description: Window end in seconds

args.name: param

args.name: option
args.description: Per-tool option patch [TOOL.]K=V (repeatable); `analyzers <ID>` lists the keys, defaults, and ranges

args.name: filter
args.description: Apply a filter GraphSpec (JSON file) before analysis

args.name: full
args.description: Include the raw result arrays

args.name: summary
args.description: Emit the summary only, without result arrays

args.name: format
args.description: Data export format: json (JSONL / provenance envelope) or csv (wide matrix). Default json

args.name: csv
args.description: Shorthand for --format csv

args.name: out
args.description: Write results to a file (one result) or a directory (one file per result) instead of stdout

args.name: pretty
args.description: Pretty-print a single result

args.name: fail-fast

annotations.description: List, get, add, update or delete the annotations in a project file (.heyl)

args.name: file
args.description: Project file (.heyl) to read or edit

args.name: json
args.description: Emit each annotation as one JSON line (JSONL) instead of a table

args.name: full
args.description: Include the full markdown body (default: a one-line excerpt)

args.name: add
args.description: Append the annotations in this JSON array file (title/body/timeSecs/range/tool)

args.name: get
args.description: Print one annotation by id (full body and frozen values)

args.name: update
args.description: Patch one annotation by id; give the fields with --set

args.name: set
args.description: With --update: FIELD=VALUE for title, body, timeSecs (time/at), range (start,end or none) or tool (id or none). Repeatable

args.name: delete
args.description: Remove one annotation by id

args.name: to
args.description: Write a changed project to this copy instead of editing it in place

compare.description: Diff one analyzer across two project files

args.name: a
args.description: Owner project file (.heyl)

args.name: b
args.description: Reference project file (.heyl)

args.name: tool
args.description: Analyzer id to compare (repeatable, one line per tool); required unless --all

args.name: all
args.description: Compare every analyzer in the catalog

args.name: start
args.description: Window start for both sides (seconds)

args.name: end
args.description: Window end for both sides (seconds)

args.name: a-start
args.description: Window start for side A only

args.name: a-end
args.description: Window end for side A only

args.name: b-start
args.description: Window start for side B only

args.name: b-end
args.description: Window end for side B only

args.name: b-offset
args.description: Move side B on the relative axis (seconds; positive = later)

args.name: overlap
args.description: Clip both sides to their absolute-time intersection

args.name: param
args.description: Shared param patch K=V applied to both sides (repeatable)

args.name: option
args.description: Per-tool option patch [TOOL.]K=V applied to both sides (repeatable)

args.name: filter
args.description: Override both saved filters with this GraphSpec (JSON file)

args.name: full
args.description: Include the raw result and delta arrays (default: compact + stats)

args.name: summary
args.description: Emit the side summaries and diff summary only

args.name: save
args.description: Write owner A back to this .heyl path with the reference snapshots, so the app reopens the comparison

args.name: open-tool
args.description: With --save, override the saved project's Workbench tabs (repeatable)

args.name: pretty
args.description: Pretty-print a single result instead of one JSON line per tool

args.name: fail-fast
args.description: Stop at the first failing tool

project.description: Build a .heyl project from a source + setup + tabs, without opening a window

args.name: dest
args.description: Destination .heyl path (parent folders are created)

args.name: source
args.description: Audio file to decode as the project source

args.name: synth
args.description: Synth GraphSpec (JSON file) to render as the source (with --seconds); instead of --source

args.name: seconds
args.description: Rendered length for --synth (default 5)

args.name: name
args.description: Project display name (default: the output file stem)

args.name: open-tool
args.description: Analyzer tab to restore when the project opens (repeatable), e.g. --open-tool spectrum

args.name: annotations
args.description: Annotations JSON file: an array of annotation objects (title/body/timeSecs/range/tool)

args.name: reference
args.description: Write a reference project (no embedded audio) for a file source

args.name: start
args.description: Analysis window start in seconds (default 0)

args.name: end
args.description: Analysis window end in seconds (default: full duration)

args.name: param
args.description: Shared param patch K=V (repeatable); same keys as analyze

args.name: option
args.description: Per-tool option patch TOOL.K=V (repeatable); name the tool, e.g. -o mfcc.nMfcc=13

args.name: filter
args.description: Save this filter GraphSpec (JSON file) into the project

args.name: pretty
args.description: Pretty-print the saved-project record
